top_signals.title: Congress Presses Nvidia Over China Chip Access
top_signals.summary: Democratic Rep. Raja Krishnamoorthi is on Bloomberg This Weekend to discuss the national security questions surrounding former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, including what Huang knew about alleged Chinese intelligence activity and whether restricted Nvidia chips reached entities in China. Speaking with hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini, Krishnamoorthi calls for stronger export controls and congressional oversight while raising questions about Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick’s handling of Nvidia and Megaspeed. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
